tax.text: Wahab said she supports raising taxes on billionaires.
tax.quote: support for Medicare for All, raising taxes on billionaires

wages.text: Her campaign platform calls for raising the federal minimum wage and creating jobs people can live on, and she is backed by unions including National Nurses United.
wages.quote: Raise the federal minimum wage, expand apprenticeships and trades, support local hiring, and create jobs that let people afford to live where they work.

debt.text: She supports protecting Medicare and Medicaid and opposes reducing basic health-care benefits to address deficits.
debt.quote: I would not balance the budget by cutting basic health care, nutrition, housing or education for working people.

housing.text: Her campaign platform calls for more funding for housing while cutting red tape and speeding up construction.
housing.quote: Increase funding for affordable, social, workforce, and starter housing; cut red tape; speed up construction; and expand paths to homeownership.

schools.text: Her campaign platform emphasizes protecting Title I and IDEA public-school funding and expanding tutoring and after-school programs.
schools.quote: Protect Title I and IDEA funding and expand tutoring and after-school.

immigration.text: Her campaign platform calls for a humane immigration system with due process and faster legal pathways.
immigration.quote: Secure, fair, and humane immigration with due process and faster legal pathways.

abortion.text: Wahab said she supports codifying abortion rights.

health.text: Wahab expressed support for Medicare for All.
health.quote: indicating support for Medicare for All

energy.text: Her campaign platform calls for accelerating clean energy and grid upgrades while also cutting energy costs.
energy.quote: Cut energy costs and stop price gouging while accelerating clean energy and grid upgrades that improve reliability.

voting.text: Her campaign platform pledges to defend voting rights and equal protection for immigrants, seniors and other vulnerable communities.
voting.quote: Defend voting rights, civil rights, and equal protection for women, seniors, kids, LGBTQ+ people, immigrants, and vulnerable communities.

tax.text: Hernandez touts keeping local taxes flat with fiscal discipline while also promising to expand federal services like Medicare and childcare support.
tax.quote: As Mayor, she kept Dublin financially strong without raising taxes

trade.text: Hernandez said she wants to remove tariffs to reduce everyday costs for consumers.
trade.quote: I support eliminating Trump's tariffs to ease everyday costs.

debt.text: Hernandez pledges to protect Social Security and Medicare from cuts.
debt.quote: protect Social Security and Medicare from cuts, and prioritize growing small businesses to strengthen our local economy

housing.text: Hernandez calls for building more housing at all affordability levels to lower housing costs.
housing.quote: To bring down the cost of housing, we need to build more houses at all levels of affordability.

safety.text: Hernandez calls for funding police staffing and resources while also expanding mental health crisis response and addiction treatment.
safety.quote: give our police officers, firefighters, and emergency responders the training, staffing, and resources they need

immigration.text: Hernandez supports a pathway to citizenship for DREAMers and undocumented residents, alongside border security.
immigration.quote: supports a real pathway to citizenship for DREAMers and undocumented community members

abortion.text: Hernandez pledges to protect reproductive healthcare and supports the Women's Health Protection Act.
abortion.quote: Melissa will also fight to protect reproductive healthcare and restore reproductive freedom by supporting legislation like the Women's Health Protection Act.

health.text: Hernandez supports expanding Medicare, restoring insurance subsidies, and lowering prescription drug costs.
health.quote: lower prescription drug costs, protect and expand Medicare, restore insurance subsidies to reduce the cost of insurance premiums

energy.text: Hernandez backs a transition to renewable energy and fully restoring the Inflation Reduction Act to cut emissions.
energy.quote: transition towards a diverse array of renewable energy sources to reduce greenhouse gas emissions
